summary: Join our Board Governance and Director Responsibilities Training Course to master essential skills for effective leadership and strategic decision-making.
lede: Board director training helps current and aspiring directors understand their responsibilities and contribute to effective board oversight. It covers fiduciary duties, the boundary between governance and management, and practical ways to question strategy and assess risk. Participants also explore board meetings, ethical decision-making, and how to track actions and follow up on decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for leaders and professionals involved in governance and board-level decision-making, ensuring they are equipped to effectively fulfill their roles.
audience: Current board members of companies, NGOs, public
Trustees and advisory board members in foundations
Audit, risk, and governance committee members
modules: Roles, Structures, and Dynamics of the Board
Strategy Oversight and Long Term Value Creation
Risk, Audit, and Internal Control Oversight
Board Meetings, Information, and Decision Quality
Ethics, Integrity, and ESG in Governance
Board Evaluations, Succession, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in board roles or in senior management positions. Familiarity with basic governance concepts is recommended.
